acceptanceCriteria: ticket search and roadmap accept the same --fields and --summary selectors as V1-0935.
Terminal-status items omit blockers and per-item unknowns; a store-wide unknown is reported once in the envelope.
Measured bytes before and after on the 900-ticket store are recorded; maintained tests cover each change.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the owner-requested token-usage audit (owner: ensure Corvint and corvint-tasks are optimal with token usage at all times). Measured on rc3-cleanup head 79536edd and 72 h of this project's Claude Code transcripts; tokens about bytes/4.

Measured: ticket search about 96 calls a day; 597 B per item, blockers 33% (for example 'status COMPLETED is not OPEN' on completed tickets), a repeated ATTEMPT_LIVE unknown 20%, and record:null emitted; 93 KB for --label agent-memory (100 of 901). Default page size 100 (internal/tasks/wire/limits.go:110). roadmap 35 KB raw. '<verb> --help' returns a MALFORMED error envelope, so agents fall back to the full 6-8 KB help. Extends the #650 selectors (V1-0935) to these reads.

Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0935-compact-agent-output.md, docs/decisions/0441-rc3-gh650-653-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the 4 sealed staged CEMs .corvint/changes/ca228a4b808e2582be6537515518ed8f2e93889d.cem.json, .corvint/changes/ca97023c1a19ce91475fc4319282d9d8b3e7f753.cem.json, .corvint/changes/e7a18bdbfe47d7f72351ddda4ed194a0936d65fc.cem.json, .corvint/changes/f587d6bf08f4ff2c46c8d1e1bb111169a1af7ce6.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0441 records the owner's acceptance of CAL-V0-165..174. The batch passed focused package tests, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal per stage, and every hosted CI check on the final head e4b50dcb (after re-freezing the source_handoff.go native digest). NOT_RUN: make gate, live dispatcher/fleet/host qualification, older-binary run against share bindings. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.
